verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated reconciliation suite (Balance Breakdown, Financial Actions by Date Range and by Payout ID, Payouts Report, Settlement Breakdown Report, Settlement Statement) for reconciling balances, fee categories, financial actions, invoices and settlements. It also maps payouts to the underlying financial actions and breaks out fee types such as the FX rate fee, which covers the core settlement-to-deposit story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that refunds and chargebacks appear as itemized line items in these reports, documented report field/column detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
